text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... ...Ngh, I have to try 
harder...

The Takarazuka Kinen... As each of them 
carried their own feelings into their 
training—

An Umamusume bearing the name of a star 
gazed out at the distant green.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, about tomorrow's training— ...Hm? Is 
that...?

Following Air Shakur's gaze, standing 
there was—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur-san...

A somewhat heavy atmosphere hung in the 
air. Admire Vega seemed to be having 
trouble with her legs, and no one had seen 
her running for a while now.

After a brief silence, Air Shakur speaks. 
It seemed vague, yet felt like a very 
clear question—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Have you already decided?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Because there's nothing we can do about 
it, is there?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you say something to them...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"What's with 'what'? Mind your own damn 
business."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Stop, or move forward. There's only 
zero or one.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's not for us to decide.

That is true. As long as I cannot walk 
right beside them, I have no right to 
meddle half-heartedly.
—However.
choice_data_list:
I think it might exist somewhere between 0 
and 1.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

To move forward, or to stand still. 
Perhaps the catalyst for that decision 
lies somewhere between 0 and 1.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
............ *sigh* Don't go spouting 
things like some mad scientist.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...We sure are bumping into each other a 
lot today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're right. ...Though it's only the 
second time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...You said earlier that there was nothing 
we could do, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Well... Ain't that the kinda line said by 
someone who wants to do somethin' about 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Damn. It's really not like me after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's not like you. ...Is that your 
Trainer's influence?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...He's the kind of guy who exists 
somewhere between 0 and 1. Even numbers 
that should divide evenly won't add up 
cleanly with him around.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm sure that has become... one 
of your greatest potentials...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, you're pretty talkative for once. 
...Still, though.
Ayabe-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't you have one too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-saaan! Um, excuse me! There's 
something I'd like to talk to you about!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Like someone caught between 0 and 1... 
Such a troublesome guy.
